Source reference for genshin-ts-derived Miliastra++ material

Upstream project: genshin-ts
Repository: https://github.com/josStorer/genshin-ts

Pinned revision:
26bdf2a9a3fadba934423940489236f0b53eb3ea

P5.3 bounded metadata fixture
--------------------------------

Miliastra++ consumer:
Tests/Phase5Milestone3Tests.cpp

Embedded fixture symbols:
AuthenticNodeMetadataJson
AuthenticNodeModesJson

Node metadata resource:
resources/client_node_metadata.json
Pinned Git blob: 93237c724f6453650ae9394077620c6e0fddb3d3

Mode resource:
resources/client_node_modes.json
Pinned Git blob: b7e14a0dd7102ccd682235cf958a2d3d36378033

P5.3 uses a bounded selected client boolean-filter subset from the pinned
node metadata resource rather than the complete upstream node metadata dataset.
The mode document is based on the pinned mode resource.

P5.4 bounded reflected-family specialization fixture
-------------------------------------------------------

Miliastra++ consumer:
Tests/Phase5Milestone4Tests.cpp

Embedded fixture symbols:
AuthenticNodeMetadataJson
AuthenticNodeModesJson

The exact bounded reflected-family fixture covers:

subType: bool_filter
graphType: 20001
nodeType: get_random_number
genericId: 200032
concrete variants:
1011 / variantKey 3,3
1012 / variantKey 7,7

Runtime fixture resources:
resources/client_node_metadata.json
Pinned Git blob: 93237c724f6453650ae9394077620c6e0fddb3d3

resources/client_node_modes.json
Pinned Git blob: b7e14a0dd7102ccd682235cf958a2d3d36378033

The runtime P5.4 fixture uses the selected record material and complete mode
document from those two pinned resources. P5.4 architecture and source-evidence
validation also materially relies on these pinned resources:

resources/client_node_static_metadata.json
Pinned Git blob: 17d0290993c1fef2d84d5105b2f23b7429a77ba3

resources/client_node_concrete_variants.json
Pinned Git blob: 7c1c52cf938458c88ee28d064515e1dc97525b65

resources/node_generics.json
Pinned Git blob: fb6d3c16203030eacab505fb0726b7424a92218e

resources/node_generics_summary.json
Pinned Git blob: 72d4e8ce38839e3e67a681ba0fd038c23629b222

resources/client_variable_specialization_seed.json
Pinned Git blob: 5750bb796f28adb29b238bb8ec889a5409078f29

client_node_metadata.json and client_node_modes.json supply the runtime test
fixture material. The remaining P5.4 resources are evidence used to verify
reflected-family and specialization semantics; they are not runtime adapter
inputs and complete copies are not vendored into Miliastra++.

Attribution and licensing
-------------------------

Miliastra++ does not claim authorship of the upstream-derived metadata. The
adjacent LICENSE file contains the upstream project's license. This directory
is reserved for attribution and licensing information associated with the
upstream-derived material.

Maintenance
-----------

This file is cumulative. When Miliastra++ adds a new implementation, test
fixture, generated or selected data set, or other material derived from or
materially based on genshin-ts, this source-reference file should be updated
in the same change with the Miliastra++ consumer path, pinned upstream
revision, relevant upstream resource paths and blobs, and the bounded purpose
for which they are used.
